reasons: The bread is central to the miracle: in scene 11 there is “more bread than should be there,” it is handed onward, and the basket remains full.
It is repeatedly passed and gathered: Miri distributes it to children, elders, fathers, and mothers, then Miri, Yonah, and Nim gather leftovers into baskets in scene 13.
It carries the theme of abundance and not keeping for oneself, shown when Miri places her leftover piece in the basket instead of saving it.
story_role: the multiplied bread that feeds the crowd and embodies abundance
